draft_first_release_contract.problem: A release.id=0 placeholder is never a valid signed value; the revised design resolves the ordering by reserving the draft before creating the custom binding predicate and final manifest.
required_sequence: Query the immutable closure-derived tag and reject any existing published/draft release with conflicting target, assets, manifest, or attestations.
Create one unique draft release with the exact source target; require nonzero release.id, exact tag/target, draft=true, and no published timestamp.
Download the Actions artifact by numeric ID, hash raw ZIP bytes, safely extract, and independently hash inner payload and binary.
Write binding.json containing exact draft release.id plus producer IDs, workflow/source fields, raw ZIP digest, inner payload digest, and closure.
Attest the raw ZIP with the exact custom subject/predicate contract and verify signer, predicate, subject, and live API facts.
Generate and attest the final manifest with the existing release ID using the separate release predicate; upload immutable assets, verify the draft API object, then publish.
forbidden_shortcuts: manifest attested before draft reservation while claiming a final release ID
overwrite existing tag or same-version bytes

official_primary_sources_consulted.finding: artifact REST fields include id, name, digest, expiry, and workflow_run metadata; no job ID, run attempt, uploader, upload step, or attestation ID
jobs API exposes id, run_id, run_attempt, head_sha, name, check_run_url, and step name/status/conclusion; no artifact ID/digest
artifact-id is REST lookup key; artifact-digest is SHA-256 of the uploaded artifact ZIP; displayed size is ZIP size
custom attestation requires subject digest plus predicate-type and exactly one predicate/predicate-path; signs an in-toto subject-to-predicate statement
custom subject-digest/predicate inputs are supported; id-token:write and attestations:write are required; artifact metadata permission is not a job binding
verification checks signed actor identity and predicate type; owner/repo/signer-workflow constraints must be supplied for exact signer policy
artifact attestations bind subject digest and predicate type; custom predicates require explicit predicate-type verification
